name: mcp-linkedin-server
description: Connect Claude to LinkedIn for profiles, companies, jobs, notifications, post content, and analytics
long_description:
# MCP LinkedIn Server

Connect Claude to your LinkedIn account. Access profiles, companies, jobs, notifications, full post content, and profile analytics through a Docker container on your machine.

## Features
- **Profile Access**: Get detailed LinkedIn profile information including work history, education, and skills
- **Company Profiles**: Extract comprehensive company data including recent posts
- **Job Details**: Retrieve job posting information and search jobs
- **Notifications**: Get recent notifications with author usernames and post URLs
- **Post Content**: Extract full (non-truncated) text from any LinkedIn post
- **Profile Analytics**: Monitor profile views, impressions, search appearances, followers

## First-Time Setup

### 1. Pre-pull Docker Image (Required)
Run this command first to avoid connection timeouts:
```
docker pull hubertusgbecker/mcp-linkedin-server:3.0.4

tools.name: get_person_profile
tools.description: Get detailed information from a LinkedIn profile including work history, education, skills, and connections

tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.description: Extract comprehensive company information and details

tools.name: get_job_details
tools.description: Retrieve specific job posting details using LinkedIn job IDs

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search for jobs with filters like keywords and location

tools.name: close_session
tools.description: Properly close browser session and clean up resources
